title: Digital Asset Loan Collateral Coverage
description: Extension schema for the vwp-digital-assets-lending extension. Constrains a core calculation object of type 'collateralCoverage': the receivable's carrying amount before allowance against the fair value of collateral held, the contractual required coverage ratio, and three distinct outputs — the coverage ratio, the margin SHORTFALL against the contractual requirement (a margin-call measure, never the allowance), and the UNSECURED PORTION (carrying amount less collateral fair value, floored at zero), which is the expected credit loss basis under the ASC 326-20-35-6 collateral maintenance expedient. Located by type under calculations/.

loanFairValue.description: The receivable's carrying amount before any allowance (its fair value under the SEC staff / AICPA model).

loanFairValueFact.description: Fact id the loan fair value is taken from; checked against the fact's value when present.

collateralFairValueFact.description: Fact id the collateral fair value is taken from; checked when present.

requiredCoverageRatioFact.description: Fact id the required ratio is taken from; checked when present.

shortfall.description: max(0, loanFairValue × requiredCoverageRatio − collateralFairValue): how much collateral the borrower must post to be back at the contractual ratio. A margin-call measure — NOT the allowance.

unsecuredPortion.description: max(0, loanFairValue − collateralFairValue): the portion of the carrying amount not covered by collateral fair value. Under ASC 326-20-35-6 expected credit losses are measured on this amount (zero when collateral covers the carrying amount).
